question: Find the mean proportional between 16 and 256.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

The mean proportional between two numbers a and b is given directly by the square root of their product.

⇒ Mean proportional = √(a × b)

⇒ Mean proportional = √(16 × 256)

⇒ Mean proportional = √16 × √256

⇒ Mean proportional = 4 × 16 = 64

**∴ The correct answer is 64.**
